row.qualification: Source-reported local NC depth in the Transect1 geostrophic-velocity discussion, not a reconstructed current bottom. Nearby citations compare the regional literature; retain attribution and approximate scope. December2011 observation with persistent late-summer hydrographic conditions is neither typical summer nor typical winter climatology. The5cm/s isotach is explicitly for transport integration in Section4.2; its use for this175m prose value is unverified. Offshore limit55km is not a measured full current width. No pairing with route length/width, regional450/250m seasonal summaries, or volume.

caveats: Distinct dated local result; existing Berta winter450m/summer250m records are undated literature summaries.
One author-reported approximate depth, not native velocity reconstruction, uncertainty range, annual extrema or whole-current thickness.
Thermocline, water-mass core and sampling depth are separate quantities; none supplies another current-bottom measurement.
